portal_description:
Red Hat Network Client Tools provide programs and libraries that allow a system to receive software updates from Red Hat Satellite.

This update adds the following enhancement:

* With Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, users no longer register to Red Hat Network and instead register to Red Hat Subscription Management. This update therefore removes the integration of the rhn_register application with the firstboot program, and replaces it with the subscription-manager application. Note that registering to Red Hat Satellite 5 still uses rhn_register, but this is no longer included in the firstboot menu and thus must be done after closing firstboot. (BZ#1000419)

Users of rhn-client-tools are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which add this enhancement.
